correctness.rationale: The 12-by-9 harmonic evaluation matrix E is full column rank by parity and plane restrictions. Explicit integer B has rank 3 and B^T E=0, hence spans the entire left kernel. Each erased row is a signed tetrahedral edge-potential difference, so rank B_T=4-c(G_T). Rank-nullity yields exactly 13-|T|-c(G_T) for every subset, with no asymptotic or numerical assumptions. Independent exact-rational elimination checked all 4096 subsets, all 13 count rows and the matrix identities from the standalone file.
